title: An End-to-End Viral Reel Automation for a Fashion E-Commerce Brand
subtitle: One workflow, concept to finished reel, with no manual editing in between
blurb: Built an n8n workflow for a US fashion e-commerce brand that generates viral reel ideas, produces the images and video, adds a soundscape, and stitches everything into a finished short-form reel automatically.
result: Automated the entire creative workflow from concept to finished reel, not just one step in the middle of it

meta.solutions: n8n, AI Image and Video Generation, Automated Video Assembly

whoFor: A fashion e-commerce brand needing a consistent volume of short-form video content without a dedicated in-house editing team.
challengeIntro: Producing short-form video content end to end, from an idea through a finished edit, meant manual work at nearly every stage of the process.
challengePoints: No system for turning an idea into a full set of visual prompts and assets
Manual video editing and sound design was slow and inconsistent
No connection between content production and the publishing pipeline
builtIntro: Built in n8n, the workflow generates viral reel ideas with AI, writes detailed visual prompts, produces the AI-generated images, turns those images into cinematic video, generates an immersive soundscape, and stitches everything into a finished short-form reel, updating the production pipeline automatically as it goes.
builtPoints: AI-generated reel concepts and detailed visual prompts
AI image generation from each prompt
Automatic stitching into a finished short-form video
builtOutro: The goal was never to automate one task in the process, it was to automate the entire creative workflow from concept to final output.
